operations.command: set -e; for unit in generate-sb-keys.service nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service; do for i in $(seq 1 300); do state=$(systemctl show -p ActiveState --value "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true); result=$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$state" = failed ] || [ "$result" = exit-code ]; then systemctl status "$unit"; exit 1; fi; if [ "$result" = success ] && [ "$state" != activating ]; then break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit")" = success; test "$(systemctl show -p ActiveState --value "$unit")" != activating; done; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) fallback=BOOTX64.EFI ;; aarch64) fallback=BOOTAA64.EFI ;; *) fallback=BOOTUNKNOWN.EFI ;; esac; for entry in /boot/loader/entries/nixos-recovery.conf /recovery/loader/entries/nixos-recovery.conf; do test -f "$entry"; grep -Fx 'linux /EFI/recovery/kernel.efi' "$entry"; grep -Fx 'initrd /EFI/recovery/initrd' "$entry"; ! grep -F 'efi /EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi' "$entry"; done; test -f /recovery/loader/loader.conf; test -f /boot/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi; test -f /boot/EFI/recovery/initrd; test -f /recovery/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi; test -f /recovery/EFI/recovery/initrd; ! test -e /boot/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi; ! test -e /recovery/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi; sbverify --list /boot/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi | grep -q 'signature certificates'; sbverify --list /recovery/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi | grep -q 'signature certificates'; sbverify --list "/recovery/EFI/BOOT/$fallback" | grep -q 'signature certificates'; bootctl list | grep -F nixos-recovery.conf; bootctl list | grep -F 'linux:'; bootctl list | grep -F 'initrd:'; printf recovery-secure-entry-ok

set -e; target=/mnt; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; bootctl status | grep -F 'Secure Boot: enabled'; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/btrfs; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/cryptsetup; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/nixos-mount; nixos-mount --help | grep -F 'Usage: nixos-mount'; printf 'testpass123
' | nixos-mount "$target"; findmnt -rn --target "$target/etc/nixos" | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos'; findmnt -rn --target "$target/var" | grep -F '@var'; findmnt -rn --target "$target/home" | grep -F '@home'; test "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE "$target/boot")" = vfat; test "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE "$target/recovery")" = vfat; nixos-mount "$target" >/tmp/nixos-mount-second.log; test -d "$target/nix/store"; test -d "$target/etc/nixos/.git"; printf recovery-secure-boot-ok

set -e; target=/mnt; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; mountpoint -q "$target/boot"; mountpoint -q "$target/recovery"; cd "$target/etc/nixos"; TMPDIR=/tmp nixos-install --root "$target" --flake "$target/etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Secure-Boot" --no-channel-copy --show-trace --no-root-password --max-jobs auto --cores 0; sbverify=$(find "$target/nix/store" -path '*/bin/sbverify' -type f | head -1); sbverify=${sbverify#$target}; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) fallback=BOOTX64.EFI ;; aarch64) fallback=BOOTAA64.EFI ;; *) fallback=BOOTUNKNOWN.EFI ;; esac; for file in /boot/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi /recovery/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi /recovery/EFI/BOOT/$fallback; do chroot "$target" "$sbverify" --list "$file" | grep -q 'signature certificates'; done; recovery_system=$(sed -n 's/.*init=\([^ ]*\)\/init.*/\1/p' "$target/boot/loader/entries/nixos-recovery.conf" | head -1); sw=$(readlink "$target$recovery_system/sw"); chroot "$target" "$sw/bin/nixos-mount" --help | grep -F 'Usage: nixos-mount'; printf recovery-mounted-reinstall-ok
